title: Nutty Crunchy Dutch Pork Croquettes
description: A Dutch dish featuring ground pork, dashi extract, and Mediterranean friendly ingredients, perfect for midnight cravings. The resinous and crunchy texture is achieved with a combination of nuts and breadcrumbs.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the ground pork, dashi extract, chopped almonds, breadcrumbs, grated Parmesan cheese, egg, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Use your hands to shape the mixture into small cylindrical croquettes.
Carefully place the croquettes in the hot oil and fry for 4-5 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Remove the croquettes from the oil and place them on a paper towel lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the croquettes hot and enjoy.
For an extra crunchy coating, you can chill the croquettes in the refrigerator for 30 minutes before frying.
To make the dish more Mediterranean friendly, you can serve the croquettes with a side of tangy tzatziki sauce.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F, then rest 3 minutes before serving.
